full_name: Nidhiya Menon | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Nidhiya Menon is an economist whose research interests lie at the intersection of development, environment, gender, health, and labor. At Radcliffe, using latest developments in climate modeling techniques and novel remote-sensed historical and contemporaneous data, she will examine the long-run impacts of climate change on low-income vulnerable women across South Asia, studying how socioeconomic inequalities and gender-specific roles entrenched in cultural norms constrain adaptive behavior and optimal choice to produce gendered health and occupation-specific outcomes.
